name: Kitaoji Satsuki
source: After attending a boy's boarding school in Switzerland, Satsuki went on to attend college and graduate school at Harvard University before succeeding his father as the president of Kitaoji Enterprises. With his good looks and knack for business, Satsuki has an international reputation as a prince of the business world.
